HanOwusuShin2026 Appendix B provides the same-target Bernoulli-to-exact-count IPW starting point; the proposed cross-label calibrated efficient score is a plausible but close refinement.

novelty_flags.label: KatoImaizumiIshiharaKitagawa2026 in bibliography, related work, and Open-ended Question 1
novelty_flags.one_line: arXiv:2506.24007 is currently authored by Masahiro Kato alone, not by Kato, Imaizumi, Ishihara, and Kitagawa; correct the attribution before relying on this comparator.

soundness_flags.label: ass:exact-count-cr
soundness_flags.one_line: The condition specifies only second-stage exact-count assignment conditional on a policy, whereas its claimed two-stage complete-randomization name also requires a first-stage complete-randomization law.

soundness_flags.label: ass:unit-bernoulli and ass:exact-count-cr
soundness_flags.one_line: These are incompatible as simultaneous assumptions for an interior policy: independent Bernoulli assignment assigns positive mass outside the exact-count slice, while exact-count assignment assigns none; define separate Bernoulli and complete-randomization regimes.

soundness_flags.label: def:mechanism-values and Theorems 4–5
soundness_flags.one_line: G_A is defined only for strictly positive rates on A, but R_CR^star takes an infimum over boundary points of Delta_K and passes the unqualified K-vector alpha to G_A; restrict to alpha_k>0 for k in A and state the A-coordinate projection.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 3 — target-tangent LAN
soundness_flags.one_line: DQM plus the displayed mean displacement does not define a target tangent experiment or identify its score/information; “target component” and the required least-favourable path must be specified before the asserted independent Gaussian limit and all-rule bound are well-posed.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 6 — rank-set coverage
soundness_flags.one_line: rank(U_k) is undefined at the partial ties over which coverage is claimed; define whether rank is a set, lower/upper rank, or a tie-breaking convention and align the inversion target with it.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The source defines two-stage complete randomization as complete randomization at the first stage and complete randomization within clusters conditional on the first-stage assignment.
The cited arXiv record is titled “Minimax and Bayes Optimal Best-Arm Identification” and lists Masahiro Kato as sole author.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Split the Bernoulli-label and complete-randomization mechanisms into explicitly alternative assumption bundles, define the fixed-count first-stage label law, and repair the positive-rate domain of the Gaussian design values.
Replace the LAN shorthand with a specified local score/tangent class and a least-favourable submodel, then define rank as a tie-aware set-valued functional before stating uniform coverage.

Make the field-level mechanism-loss result harder to dismiss as homogeneity: add a general-menu numerical certificate or a nontrivial design corollary with calibrated achievable risk, not only the lower ratio.
Correct the Kato citation and retain exact version/section anchors for Han, Joo, and Kato in the comparison table.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two design regimes and the Gaussian/LAN/rank definitions, correct the Kato comparator record, then rerun novelty review before Stage 0.
